verdict.rationale: The evidence covers onboarding an already-working robot onto Formant's cloud platform: Docker-based agent install on ROS1/ROS2, device configuration templates, and teleoperation over WebRTC. That is an adjacent capability, not hardware bring-up. Nothing shows Formant supplying or speeding up hardware drivers, low-level robot configuration, or achieving first motion on new hardware, and no evidence supports a bring-up time of hours rather than weeks. Its teleop and commands assume the robot's own control stack already runs.
